name: meshsat-pinedio-bridge
description: The Pine64 LoRa back cover's I2C-to-SPI bridge as a transport for an SX1262 driver: SPI frames over the ATtiny84, with stand-ins for the BUSY, DIO1 and reset lines the bridge does not have. Includes a RadioLib hardware abstraction.
keywords: lora, sx1262, pinephone, pinedio, radiolib, meshtastic, i2c
